## Fetch one page as Markdown

Call this workflow with {"url":"https://example.com/page"}. Configure FireCrawl HTTP Header Auth as Authorization: Bearer <your Firecrawl API key>. The v2 scrape uses Markdown, main content, maxAge0 and30000ms timeout. Return response and optional pageStatus. API success does not imply target HTTP success: a target error page can also contain Markdown. See README.
